mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.username, m.content, m.is_top, m.create_time FROM message m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.is_top DESC, m.create_time DESC

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.username, m.content, m.is_top, m.create_time FROM message m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.is_top DESC, m.create_time DESC

SELECT m.topic, m.id, m.user_id AS userId, u.username, m.content, m.is_top AS isTop, m.create_time AS createTime FROM message m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON m.user_id = u.id
m.status = 1
AND (m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY m.is_top DESC, m.create_time DESC

SELECT m.topic, m.id, m.user_id AS userId, u.username, m.content, m.is_top AS isTop, m.create_time AS createTime, m.visibility, m.visible_usernames AS visibleUsernames FROM message m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON m.user_id = u.id
m.status = 1
AND (m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND ( -- 1. 公有留言所有人可见 m.visibility = 0 -- 2. 登录用户可以看自己发布的
OR m.user_id = #{currentUserId}
-- 3. 指定用户可见，且当前用户名在列表中
OR (m.visibility = 2 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{currentUsername}, m.visible_usernames))
)
ORDER BY m.is_top DESC, m.create_time DESC

SELECT m.topic, m.id, m.user_id AS userId, u.username, m.content, m.is_top AS isTop, m.create_time AS createTime FROM message m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
